trigger: Manual user request: jos tolko, followed by nastavi

catalogue.qualification: Exactly eighteen distinct new records. Earlier records and publication dates are preserved. No expired guide or source date was silently renewed.

method: Catalogue, deferred candidates, previous reports and Git history checked before selection. Public-source guides distinguish visitor actions from operator marketing. No EA attendance, local validation, provider partnership, purchase, private permission, joint booking or transfer is implied.

automatedAccessExceptions.validation: The official council page was read through ordinary web retrieval on 21 October. The local automated browser received a security-verification page. No challenge bypass attempted. The separate council remediation page returned 200 and establishes the route's closure boundary.

The official current park product was available in normal web search, with its indexed content crawled the previous day. A fresh open encountered a redirect loop and the local browser received an explicit Web Page Blocked response. No bypass attempted. The two current Serralves institutional route/park sources returned 200. No date, stock, price or ticket availability is guaranteed.

sources.scope: Official operators, municipal institutions, transport authorities, bathhouse union and dance federation. Current Japanese source corrects stale translated Kyoto bath hours. Current temple schedule image was visually read. No booking, payment, form submission or third-party contact occurred.

photography.rightsBoundary: Attribution is not permission. The three operator-published class photographs follow the established EA moderate-risk policy and explicitly state that reuse rights are not independently cleared. Fifteen openly licensed photographs retain creator, direct source, licence and applicable share-alike attribution. Expressly restricted city-tourism images and ambiguous outside-publication images were not used.
photography.creditFormat: Image: author / source ↗ with a direct source in a new tab
photography.depictionBoundary: Historical documentary images never establish current layout, staffing, admission or weather. Nice's licensed socca image is explicitly wider local context, not a false claim that its vendor is Chez Pipo. The 1974 Toronto image and pre-replacement Tokyo organ photograph were rejected. The Toronto guide uses a non-generative central crop of a June 2026 panorama.

integration.qualification: Valencia's existing chapter is currently hidden because its Water Tribunal evidence window expired. The full-sequence safety rule is retained, not weakened.

guides.title: Find Hanoi's coffee beneath the egg cream
guides.eaValue: Order egg coffee at Café Giảng's Nguyễn Hữu Huân address and let a small cup interrupt your Old Quarter walk.

guides.title: Taste Nice in a hot piece of socca
guides.eaValue: Share a freshly served chickpea pancake near Nice's port and pay attention to the crisp edge before it softens.

guides.title: Give a Viennese coffeehouse an unhurried hour
guides.eaValue: Sit down at Café Sperl and let the room, a coffee and something to read become a proper part of the day.

guides.title: Give Harris Tweed a bag-shaped afternoon
guides.eaValue: Choose a cloth panel and prepared components at an Edinburgh workshop, then assemble the bag you will carry away.

guides.title: Compose a Berlin scent by smelling before naming
guides.eaValue: Compare house fragrances with a scent expert and choose a personal combination at Frau Tonis in Berlin.

guides.title: Lift a sheet of paper from a Taipei rooftop vat
guides.eaValue: Join the Suho Memorial Paper Museum's scheduled papermaking session and watch wet fibres become something you can hold.

guides.title: Let the Star Ferry put Hong Kong in motion
guides.eaValue: Take the scheduled Central to Tsim Sha Tsui crossing and give the harbour a practical role in your day.

guides.title: Cross to Ward's Island and let Toronto recede
guides.eaValue: Use the municipal ferry to reach Toronto's islands, then choose a manageable public-path walk with the return timetable in mind.

guides.title: Walk from Bondi to Tamarama with time to look
guides.eaValue: Take a bounded section of Sydney's coastal path and let rock, surf and the next bay share your attention.

guides.title: Meet Porto's trees at canopy height
guides.eaValue: Walk Serralves' elevated timber route and look across a park from a level normally left to branches.

guides.title: Step off Madrid's timetable at Chamberí
guides.eaValue: Book a guided visit to a former metro station and read the tiled advertising of a platform trains no longer serve.

guides.title: Hear the instruments inside Paris's music museum
guides.eaValue: Use the Musée de la musique's listening guide to connect an instrument in a case with the sound it can make.

guides.title: Step below Neukölln's streets into Körnerpark
guides.eaValue: Find a sunken public garden in Berlin and let the change in level give an ordinary pause a different setting.

guides.title: Give Kyoto an ordinary bathhouse evening
guides.eaValue: Enter Funaoka Onsen as a bather, not a spectator, and let a historic neighbourhood sentō slow the evening.

guides.title: Bring a book to Florence's Oblate courtyard
guides.eaValue: Use a public library's quieter spaces for a reading pause instead of making the next stop another ticket.

guides.title: Give a Greenwich Village jazz set your full attention
guides.eaValue: Book one Village Vanguard set and let a small listening room, rather than a long evening's checklist, decide the pace.

guides.title: Watch a sardana circle form outside Barcelona's cathedral
guides.eaValue: Choose a confirmed public ballada and listen to the cobla before deciding whether to join the dance.

guides.title: Hear a pipe organ inside a Tokyo Buddhist temple
guides.eaValue: Attend Tsukiji Hongwanji's scheduled lunchtime concert and hear an unexpected instrument within a working temple.
